ui.admin.connectors.f.emailSender: Send all of this organisation's email through this connector
ui.admin.connectors.h.placeholders: Placeholders in double braces: record.<field>, message.to, message.subject, message.text, message.mime, organisation.name, secrets.<name>, credential.accessToken.
ui.admin.connectors.h.headers: An object of header names and their values.
ui.admin.connectors.h.inputs: Record fields the address and body may use.
ui.admin.connectors.h.responseMap: An object naming each value the lookup returns, with its path in the answer, such as data.name.

ui.admin.connectors.h.emailSender: Used instead of the organisation's mail server.

ui.admin.connectors.connectedUntil: Connected. The access token is valid until {time}.

ui.admin.migration.intro: Bring in the tables of another system as CSV files. Any file is accepted, with its own columns; you choose which record types each one fills.
ui.admin.migration.denied: You do not have access to data migration. Ask an administrator who can migrate data.
ui.admin.migration.name: Name
ui.admin.migration.empty: No migration yet. Name one, then add the CSV files you exported.
ui.admin.migration.isRunning: This migration is running. Files, mappings and books cannot change until it ends.
ui.admin.migration.filesIntro: Add every table you exported. Each file keeps its own header row and columns. Up to 10 MB and 20,000 rows a file.
ui.admin.migration.mapIntro: Choose the record types this file fills. One row can fill several, for example a supporter and their donation. Columns you leave out are not imported.
ui.admin.migration.noTypes: There is no record type to fill yet. Add one in the Builder first.
ui.admin.migration.oldIdHint: A later file points at this record by this value, and a second run updates the record instead of adding another.
ui.admin.migration.required: Every row must make this record
ui.admin.migration.requiredHint: When off, a row whose old id for this record is empty, or whose cells for it are wrong, still loads its other records.
ui.admin.migration.orderIntro: Files load from top to bottom. A file that looks up records by old id waits for the files that write them.
ui.admin.migration.leftOut: Not mapped; left out of the run
ui.admin.migration.booksIntro: Opening balances and the next receipt number apply once, after every file has loaded. Old transfers are not replayed as journals.
ui.admin.migration.booksNoPermission: You cannot set the books of a migration.
ui.admin.migration.checkIntro: Nothing is saved. Every row of every mapped file goes through the same checks as a save, in load order.
ui.admin.migration.sourceCheck: {ready} ready · {invalid} with problems · {creates} to create · {updates} to update
ui.admin.migration.runIntro: You can leave this page. Automations, mail and receipts stay off for the run.
ui.admin.migration.cancelRequested: The run stops after the current batch.
ui.admin.migration.stopped: The run stopped. Rows already loaded stay; check and run again to load the rest.
ui.admin.migration.notRun: Not run yet. Check the files, then run.
